payload.content: A staffing WordPress website separating employer recruitment needs from candidate applications across hospitality, production, logistics and horticulture.
payload.description_1: QuickTemp serves employers looking for flexible staffing and candidates looking for work across several sectors. Those journeys need different information: businesses start from workforce needs and job types, while candidates need a simple way to indicate their preferred work and availability.
payload.description_2: I separated employer-oriented sector and staffing content from the candidate signup route. Hospitality, production, logistics and horticulture provide clear work contexts, while candidates can apply directly through a focused form instead of first navigating an unsupported vacancy catalogue. Employer and candidate actions remain separated throughout the responsive journey.
